# Configuration

Every environment variable the bridge reads. Copy `.env.example` to `.env` (Node, Docker Compose) or set these in your host (Railway → service → Variables).
Empty values count as unset. Environment variables always win over `/setup`; `/setup` shows them as "set by env".
Everything else (formats, ranks, commands, join requirements, filters) is configured in Discord with `/setup`.

## Required

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DISCORD_TOKEN` 🔒 | yes | — | Discord bot token (Developer Portal → your application → Bot → Reset Token). |
| `OWNER_ID` | yes | — | Your Discord user ID. Runs `/setup`, receives Microsoft sign-in codes and outage alerts by DM. |
| `GUILD_CHANNEL_ID` | yes | — | Discord channel bridged to guild chat for account 1. |

## Discord

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `OFFICER_CHANNEL_ID` | no | — | Discord channel bridged to officer chat for account 1. Officer relay is off when unset. |
| `STAFF_ROLE_ID` | no | — | Role allowed to run staff commands. When unset, staff commands are owner-only. |
| `DISCORD_SERVER_ID` | no | — | Restrict the bot to one Discord server and publish slash commands there instantly. Interactions and messages from any other server are ignored. |
| `LOG_CHANNEL_ID` | no | — | Channel for error and alert logs. |

## Hypixel and Minecraft

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `HYPIXEL_API_KEY` 🔒 | no | — | Hypixel API key, sent only as the `API-Key` header. Without it, live stat commands, join requirements, GEXP, verify/link and Apply reply with a one-line notice naming this variable. |
| `MINECRAFT_HOST` | no | `mc.hypixel.net` | Server the Minecraft accounts connect to. |

## Multiple guilds (accounts and relay groups)

The first login of each account DMs a Microsoft device code to OWNER_ID; the tokens are stored in the database, so redeploys don't ask again.

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RELAY_GROUP` | no | — | Relay group of account 1. Accounts with the same group share guild and officer chat across guilds. |
| `ACCOUNT_LABEL` | no | `G1` | Short label for account 1 (max 16 characters), shown on lines relayed to other guilds. |
| `ACCOUNT_<n>_GUILD_CHANNEL_ID` | no | — | Guild chat channel of account n (2 ≤ n ≤ 99). Setting it adds the account, and it is required for every extra account. |
| `ACCOUNT_<n>_OFFICER_CHANNEL_ID` | no | — | Officer chat channel of account n. |
| `ACCOUNT_<n>_RELAY_GROUP` | no | — | Relay group of account n. |
| `ACCOUNT_<n>_LABEL` | no | `G<n>` | Label of account n (max 16 characters). |

## Storage

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DATABASE_URL` 🔒 | no | — | `mongodb://`, `mongodb+srv://`, `postgres://` or `postgresql://` URL. Unset: SQLite at `./data/bridge.db`, or on the Railway Volume. See docs/storage.md. |

## REST API

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REST_API_TOKEN` 🔒 | no | — | Enables the REST API. At least 16 characters; clients send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. See [REST API](rest-api.md). Also used by the dashboard service as `BRIDGE_TOKEN`. |
| `REST_API_PORT` | no | `3000` | Port the REST API listens on. |
| `DASHBOARD_API` | no | `false` | Enables the dashboard endpoints on the REST API (settings, lists, audit, live events). Needs REST_API_TOKEN. Leave off unless you run the dashboard service; anyone with the token gets admin access to these endpoints. |

## GuildLB (optional)

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GUILDLB_API_KEY` 🔒 | no | — | GuildLB website-api key: stored networth for `!nw` when there is no Hypixel key. |
| `GUILDLB_GUILD_KEY` 🔒 | no | — | GuildLB guild-api key bound to your guild: alliance blacklist checks and `/alliance`. Must differ from `GUILDLB_API_KEY`. |
| `GUILDLB_API_URL` | no | `https://guildlb.com` | GuildLB base URL. https only, with no query string or credentials. |

## Runtime

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LOG_LEVEL` | no | `info` | One of `debug`, `info`, `warn`, `error`. |
| `NODE_OPTIONS` | no | `--max-old-space-size=256` | Node.js flags. Must be set in the process environment (Docker, Compose, Railway), not in `.env`, because Node reads it before the bridge starts. Preset in the Docker image, docker-compose.yml and the Railway template. |

## Set by the platform

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT` | no | — | Older Railway environment marker. Any Railway marker turns on the "SQLite needs a Volume" guard. |
| `RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT_NAME` | no | — | Set by Railway. Marks the process as running on Railway. |
| `RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT_ID` | no | — | Set by Railway. Marks the process as running on Railway. |
| `RAILWAY_PROJECT_ID` | no | — | Set by Railway. Marks the process as running on Railway. |
| `RAILWAY_VOLUME_MOUNT_PATH` | no | — | Set by Railway when a Volume is attached. The SQLite file goes to `<path>/bridge.db`. |
| `RAILWAY_RUN_UID` | no | `0` | Read by Railway, not the bridge: the uid the container runs as. The template sets `0` because Railway mounts Volumes as root (docs.railway.com/volumes#permissions). |

🔒 = secret. Never paste it into an issue, a log excerpt or a screenshot.
